description: Returns booked appointments (across all calendars) in a date window. Use scheduleid from here as input to update_schedule.php.

request_body.atdate: date (YYYY-MM-DD) - starting date, max today+31 days. Today's date IS accepted (verified 2026-09-07, 226 records from today+7d).
request_body.interval: number 0-7 - window size in days, default 7
request_body.schedule_form: number, optional - none/0=All, 1=Appointment, 3=Agenda (leads created by post_schedule.php without patientid). VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-07 via n8n: 3 returned only the Agenda record, 1 only appointments, 0 both. Value 2 undocumented.

response.status_200_shape: JSON array (not an object) of appointment records

record_schema.type: string - appointment type, e.g. 'Consultație'; EMPTY string for Agenda records.
record_schema.state: string - Romanian status label (lng=1). Observed live: 'Programat' (scheduled), 'Confirmat' (confirmed), 'Anulat' (cancelled), 'Încheiat' (completed), 'Nu s-a prezentat' (no-show). Agenda records use 'Programat' too, and 'Anulat' after update_schedule state=2.
record_schema.scheduleid: string - opaque encrypted id, required input to update_schedule.php
record_schema.form: string - NEW in v4: 'Appointment' for real appointments (CRM patient), 'Agenda' for leads/agenda insertions. Verified 2026-09-07.

notes: IMPORTANT: live call with atdate=2026-09-01, interval=7 returned 226 real patient records (names + phone numbers). This is real PII from Optofarm's production system.

Real record content was intentionally NOT saved into this doc file (or anywhere in the repo) to avoid persisting patient PII in docs. Only the field schema above is documented, with a redacted example.
If test/sample data is needed for n8n or ElevenLabs agent development, fetch live via the API rather than storing sample PII in version control.

VERIFIED 2026-09-07: Agenda/lead records ARE returned (schedule_form=0 or 3) and carry a scheduleid that update_schedule.php accepts (cancel tested). Agenda scheduleids look like base64 with '=' padding replaced by ',' (ends with ',,') - pass through unchanged.

This is the ONLY way to find a lead by phone: get_schedule_patient.php does not return Agenda records even with schedule_form=0/3 (verified). The n8n FIND/MAN branches therefore scan 5 windows (today..+31d) and filter by phone+name client-side.
